features.availability: All constituent closes are available by decision_time; the current release bar closes exactly at decision_time.
features.formula: log(close_t / close_(t-1)) minus the same-boundary cross-sectional median log return
features.lag: zero additional bars after the source bar closes
features.missing_rule: Omit a symbol unless its latest contiguous 8h suffix is long enough; flatten if fewer than 12 symbols remain.

features.availability: Only residual returns strictly before the current release return are included.
features.formula: sample_std(last 9 prior residual returns) / sample_std(last 63 prior residual returns)
features.lag: current release return excluded from numerator and denominator
features.missing_rule: Omit non-finite or effectively zero slow-volatility symbols. A ratio at or above 0.86 is hard-inactive and is removed before cross-sectional score centering or selection.

features.availability: The numerator is the newly closed residual return; its scale is the prior 9-bar residual volatility.
features.formula: abs(current residual return) / max(prior fast residual volatility, 1e-12)
features.lag: prior volatility scale; current closed return
features.missing_rule: Omit if the prior scale is unavailable.

features.availability: All direction bars are closed by decision_time.
features.formula: sum(last 3 residual returns) / (prior fast volatility * sqrt(3))
features.lag: current and two prior closed residual returns
features.missing_rule: Omit if the contiguous return suffix is insufficient.

features.availability: Current dispersion uses the newly closed cross section; baseline values end one bar earlier.
features.formula: current median absolute residual return / median(previous 42 cross-sectional median absolute residual returns)
features.missing_rule: Flatten if the aligned cross section or baseline is insufficient.

features.availability: All inputs satisfy their individual rules above.
features.formula: linear dispersion-ratio mix of compression-conditioned directional continuation and failed-release convergence
features.missing_rule: Require five scores above +0.025 and five below -0.025 after median centering; otherwise flatten.

raw_fields.coverage: Only symbols in the point-in-time eligible set supplied by the organizer.
raw_fields.lag: bar must be fully closed at decision_time
raw_fields.missing_rule: Reject non-finite/nonpositive values; never forward fill.

raw_fields.lag: bar must be fully closed at decision_time
raw_fields.missing_rule: Reject negative/non-finite values; require positive trailing median for inclusion.

raw_fields.coverage: Weekly point-in-time membership intersected with next-open executability.
raw_fields.missing_rule: Bars keys must exactly equal the eligible set; duplicates or malformed symbols reject the call.
Not used as a feature; any non-past row rejects the context.
